name: Update hypotheses when new evidence arrives
trigger: When a patient response or examination report adds relevant information.
action: Compare the new information with each active hypothesis. Record supporting, opposing, and still-unknown evidence before selecting the next action.
decision_rule: Revise the working differential when new evidence contradicts the leading hypothesis; retain plausible alternatives while key checks remain unresolved.
effect: Keeps the working differential linked to accumulated evidence.
pitfall: Repeating the initial diagnosis without checking new contradictory information.
example_status: Adapted illustration; not a measured experimental output
